comparison.objective: Brace a pan and whisk an egg until mixed while preventing spill and keeping the pan flat; candidate impacts and recovers metal tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use bimanual stabilization and force regulation, but whisking/mixing loose bodies differs from coaxial tool alignment, hammer strikes, fracture, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Yolk and white mixed, all egg retained, only whisk contact, and pan flat versus four notch fractures with every tang in a tray and no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Shared stabilization and spill/loss avoidance are generic; the physical transformations are different.
